ajñadṛṣṭāveva sthito rāmo guruvacanaviśvāsātparokṣatayaiva pūrṇatāsthitiṃ
paryālocya virodhaṃ manyamānaḥ śaṅkate - bhagavanniti

kimasāvajñadṛṣṭāvavasthitaḥ śaṅkate utābhijñatāṃ
kāṃcitprāpto'ntarālavatīṃ sanniti parīkṣituṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ
sarvaśaktitāvādābhyupagamena pariharati - rājaputretyādinā

yathā jalarāśeḥ samudrasya jalāśayo jalapūra ullāsena candrodayanimittakena
svāvirbhāviṇa praphullatīti praphul

saṃhitāyāṃ halo
yamām ityanena madhyavartilalopa iti jñeyam

saṃcitāṃśca phalamukhena darśayati -
upabhogairbibharti punastirobhāvena kṣipayati

tattarhi niṣkalaṅkasya parameśvarasya yā
jagadbhāvāpattistvayoktā iyaṃ kalaṅkāpattiruktā syādityarthaḥ

tattvadṛśā vasiṣṭho jagataścidbhāvamevamavikāratāṃ ca paśyansamādhatte
- brahmaivedamiti

ajñadṛṣṭāveva sthito rāmaḥ sarvathā ānandaikarasasvabhāve
tadviruddhaduḥkhajagadrūpatā brahmaṇo durvacaiveti pratyavatiṣṭhate -
nirduḥkhamiti

evaṃ niruttarīkṛtasya vasiṣṭhasya rāmaprabodhanopāyacintāṃ vālmīkirdarśayati
- ityukte ityādinā

yaḥ puruṣo vyutpannamanā jagato jaḍabhāvaṃ vihāya cidekarasatāṃ draṣṭuṃ
samartha iti yāvat
tasya dṛśā kasyacidvastunaḥ kaścidapi doṣo virodho nāsti

alaṃ samyak yāvannoktaṃ
nopadiṣṭamasmābhistāvadeva rāghavo viśrāntiṃ naiti na prāpnoti

paraṃtu ardhavyutpannadṛṣṭeretat prāguktaṃ sarvaṃ brahmetyupadeśanaṃ na
śobhate

yata eṣo'rdhavyutpanno dṛśyānyānayatyupasthāpayati
saṃjīvayatīti vā dṛśyānā
aniteḥ kvipi āpaṃ caivaṃ halantānām iti ṭāpū
kasya tarhi tādṛśopadeśo yujyate tamāha - parāmiti

attvajña evānadhikāryupadeśe pravartate tasya śiṣyapratārakasya yukto narakapāta
ityāśayenāha - aparīkṣyeti

yadi na jñāsyasi tarhi siddhāntakāle vaktavyaṃ
nādhunetyarthaḥ

sāṃpratamardhavyutpannayogyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāguktasarvaśaktitvādi pratīcaḥ
sarvāhaṃbhāvadarśanaṃ ca prathamamupadiśati - brahma sarvaśaktīti

māyayaivāsya sarvaśaktitā pratīcaḥ sārvātmyaṃ ceti prapañcayati -
yathendrajālina ityādinā

yadvaddevaśaktyā asaṃbhāvitānyapi
nandanavanaratnastabakādīni saṃbhāvyante tadvadātmaśaktyāpi saṃbhāvyatāmiti
bhāvaḥ

vastuvyatyaya iva deśakālavyatyayo'pi māyāśaktyaiva saṃbhāvanīya
ityāśayenāha - bhaviṣyati gagane iti

vyoma naṣṭacchāyāñjanaṃ
nirastanailyakajjalaṃ kṛtvā dharātalaṃ bhūpradeśaṃ nayati prāpayati

jagati yatkiṃcidasti bhaviṣyati babhūva tatsarva raktakuṭṭimeṣu
padmarāgamaṇimayasaudhabhāveṣu ākāśapratibimbamivādhiṣṭhānaraktimnā
raktaṃ svato'sadapi brahmasattayā sadiva bhavatītyarthaḥ

evaṃ caikameva vastu sarvathā sarvaṃ bhavatīti nāsaṃbhāvanā
harṣāmarṣādayaśca yuktā ityāha - sarvameveti

evamasaṃbhāvanāṃ rāmasya nirasya prāguktasamatāsthitimeva vidhatte -
samatayaiveti

sāmagrīyuktāvasthāyuktiḥ phalāvasthāracaneti pravṛttinimittabhedādyuktiḥ
racanāṃ karotīti sāmānādhikaraṇyam
kiṃ tarhyanena prakaṭatāmāgatāḥ śaktayo vyavahriyante iti kathaṃcidyojyam
iyaṃ ca vyavahāradṛṣṭiḥ kalpanaiva paramārthatastu aviracitameva jagat

tādṛśe'pi paramārthe sati jagatsaṃpattau dṛṣṭāntapradarśakau
ślokāvavatārayati - satyeva(?

evaṃ ca svasaṃnidhimātrājjāyamānajagaddoṣairalipyamāna evātmā jagataḥ
karteva harteva niyanteva nabha iva tārakākusumarāśīnāṃ bhavatītyāha -
nirdoṣavadevetyādinā

kevale nabhasi tārakāḥ kusumarāśaya iva
kadācitprakaṭāstasminbhavantīti sarvatra śeṣaḥ

itthaṃ cāsato jagataḥ asattātmako nāśaḥ svata eva sattātmikā utpattiḥ sthitiśca
brahmasattaiveti vibhāge phalitamāha - naśyatītyāvisārdhaślokadvayena

ātmasattāyā jagatyadhyāso jagato janma nātmano
bhedābhāvādityāśayenoktamupasaṃharati - tasmāditi

astu padārthānāmavatārastairātmanaḥ kathaṃ saṃsāraprāptiriti taddarśayati -
athatīrṇānāmiti

prakṛtyā cārurityādivadabhede prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam iti
tṛtīyā
